name: google-classroom
title: Google Classroom
description: Browse your Google Classroom courses, announcements and assignments, and download their attachments
author: anupchavan

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: Client ID of your own iOS OAuth client (bundle ID com.raycast) from a Google Cloud project with the Classroom and Drive APIs enabled. See the README.

preferences.name: groupAssignments
preferences.title: All Assignments
preferences.label: Group assignments by status
preferences.description: When disabled, All Assignments is a single list ordered by most recently updated.

preferences.name: assignmentGroup1
preferences.title: Assignment Group 1
preferences.description: Choose the display order of assignment groups. Repeated groups appear once; any omitted groups follow.

preferences.name: assignmentGroup2
preferences.title: Assignment Group 2
preferences.description: Choose the display order of assignment groups. Repeated groups appear once; any omitted groups follow.

preferences.name: assignmentGroup3
preferences.title: Assignment Group 3
preferences.description: Choose the display order of assignment groups. Repeated groups appear once; any omitted groups follow.

preferences.name: assignmentGroup4
preferences.title: Assignment Group 4
preferences.description: Choose the display order of assignment groups. Repeated groups appear once; any omitted groups follow.

preferences.name: assignmentGroup5
preferences.title: Assignment Group 5
preferences.description: Choose the display order of assignment groups. Repeated groups appear once; any omitted groups follow.

preferences.name: searchTeachers
preferences.title: Course Search
preferences.label: Also search teacher names
preferences.description: When enabled, course search fetches the teacher rosters of your courses. Disable for faster searches.

commands.name: show-courses
commands.title: Show Courses
commands.subtitle: Google Classroom
commands.description: Browse your Google Classroom courses and their announcements, assignments, questions and materials

commands.name: show-assignments
commands.title: Show Assignments
commands.subtitle: Google Classroom
commands.description: See your assignments across all courses, filtered by missing, due soon, no due date and more

tools.name: get-courses
tools.title: Get Courses
tools.description: List the user's Google Classroom courses

tools.name: get-assignments
tools.title: Get Assignments
tools.description: List the user's assignments across courses with their due date and submission status

tools.name: get-course-stream
tools.title: Get Course Stream
tools.description: List the announcements, assignments, questions and materials of a course

tools.name: download-attachments
tools.title: Download Attachments
tools.description: Download the attachments of an assignment, announcement or material, or the files submitted for an assignment, to the Downloads folder

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
